facets.description: Google Calendar refreshAccessToken reads res?.data, but the sync branch returns a fetch Response, so token is undefined and reading token.access_token throws a TypeError
HubSpot refreshAccessToken expects a HubspotToken object, but the sync branch returns a fetch Response
Zoho Bigin reads tokenInfo.data.error as if it were an axios response, but the sync branch returns a fetch Response
Zoho Bigin passes credentialId instead of credential.userId to refreshOAuthTokens, so the sync endpoint gets the wrong calcomUserId
refreshOAuthTokens producer: the sync branch returns the raw fetch Response without parsing or normalizing it, so its shape differs from what each refreshFunction returns
